rows.text: reads five words starting at `+0xD48` of qword `0209AC30` with stride `0x20` and returns 0 at the first one that is neither `0xFFFF` nor `0x1000`; returns 1 when all five are one of those two values

builds a stack block of a zero dword followed by the sign-extended `ecx` and `edx` as qwords; when qword `+0x108` of qword `0209AC30` is null, calls `003FF160` + 0x4D with (`0x190`, `003FF360`, the block), stores the result to that `+0x108` and calls `003FF160` + 0x6A with (qword `0208EA28`, the result); when `+0x108` is already non-null it does neither; both paths end with the stack-cookie check (cookie `01F44830`) at `003FF160` + 0x77
when qword `+0x108` of qword `0209AC30` is non-null, stores `ecx` to its dword `+0x178` and `rdx` to its qword `+0x180`; otherwise does nothing
